listing.name: Lode Runner (2009 XBLA, darkuni Recomp)
listing.summary: Play Lode Runner with darkuni's Windows recompilation and your own purchased Xbox 360 package.

steps.title: Prepare your original beside the program
steps.instruction: Copy your own purchased full Lode Runner Xbox 360 LIVE package (title 5841085B, default.xex 0.0.1.2) beside lode_runner.exe as the complete 5841085B console export folder (5841085B/000D0000/<package>). Keep your original export separately.

steps.title: Use the documented Windows prerequisites
steps.instruction: The package README calls for 64-bit Windows 10 or 11 and the Microsoft Visual C++ 2015–2022 x64 Redistributable when its runtime libraries are missing.

steps.title: Complete first-run setup
steps.instruction: Start lode_runner.exe and let it prepare assets from your package on first start.

steps.title: Keep your settings and saves
steps.instruction: Keep the generated assets, lode_runner.toml and the 5841085B folder with the program. Saves and the shader cache stay in Documents\lode_runner.

warnings: The package includes recompiled game code that the project license does not cover. Portcove downloads it only from the project’s own releases. You need your own purchased full game package; the program always runs as the full game and does not grant or change an entitlement.
Keep the upstream folder outside the Portcove library. Close the game before backing up or replacing the creating runtime and its data.
The reviewed package README lists OutRun Online Arcade’s title ID in its export example. Use Lode Runner’s 5841085B title folder.

presentation.manual_preparation: Before first Play, copy your own purchased full Lode Runner Xbox 360 LIVE package (title 5841085B, default.xex 0.0.1.2) into the managed Lode Runner folder as the complete 5841085B console export folder (5841085B/000D0000/<package>), and keep your original separately. Lode Runner always runs as the full game; that does not grant or change an entitlement, so use only a full package you own. On first Play, the game finds the package and extracts it into assets beside lode_runner.exe; without a package it explains what it needs and closes and checks that default.xex is version 0.0.1.2. If it says your files are a different version, delete assets, replace the 5841085B folder with a package whose default.xex is 0.0.1.2 and start again. This download is the recompiled program with its runtime and contains no game data; the project license does not cover the recompiled game code. Portcove preserves the 5841085B folder, assets and lode_runner.toml across updates and backups. Once the game has started, you can delete the copied 5841085B folder so it is not kept in backups; assets is all the game needs. Logs and crash reports beside the program are diagnostics. Saves and the shader cache are in Documents\lode_runner, outside the managed copy, so Portcove neither backs them up nor removes them, and rollback does not rewind them. Install the Microsoft Visual C++ 2015–2022 Redistributable (x64) if the game does not start. Portcove replaces the program; upstream owns package import and save formats.
